scope: Retrospective descriptive ROC/DET and archived parent residual attributes only, no fit, no threshold selection or veto. H2 frozen point unchanged. H3 on hold.

roc.rule: Descriptive highest empirical TPR among actual ROC points <= cap. No threshold exported or adopted. Conditional synthetic candidate FPR differs from pipeline FPR. Report count resolution 1/720 and per-seed curves; 432 positive, 720 negative. DET false rejection vs false acceptance.

residual.rule: Read authenticated H and F group rows, assert exact row parity and frozen noise parent survival. All 38 parent controls including unsupported; use signed held-block differences averaged over primary ON; nearest competing hypothesis vs narrow: broad/constant/shifted choose lowest loss (most negative difference) only if nonzero and strictly unique, otherwise narrow or ambiguous. Compare primary and repeat ON consistency; OFF narrow over constant in both ON/OFF pairs flag descriptive shared-like. No causal RFI labels; no random-noise assertion from constant-like. No change thresholds or model. Tabulate count of supported, unknown, disagreement, class overlap, per row and per group; historical labels already viewed.
